The state is \( |\psi\rangle = 0.5 |\uparrow\rangle + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} |\downarrow\rangle \), which is normalized. The expectation value of \(10\sigma_z + 5\sigma_x\) is \(10\langle\sigma_z\rangle + 5\langle\sigma_x\rangle\).

\(\langle\sigma_z\rangle = |0.5|^2 (1) + \left|\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right|^2 (-1) = 0.25 - 0.75 = -0.5\).

For \(\sigma_x\), using \(\sigma_x|\uparrow\rangle = |\downarrow\rangle\) and \(\sigma_x|\downarrow\rangle = |\uparrow\rangle\),  
\(\sigma_x|\psi\rangle = 0.5|\downarrow\rangle + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}|\uparrow\rangle\). Then  
\(\langle\sigma_x\rangle = \langle\psi|\sigma_x|\psi\rangle = 0.5\cdot\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\cdot0.5 = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \approx 0.8660\).

Thus \(10\langle\sigma_z\rangle + 5\langle\sigma_x\rangle = 10(-0.5) + 5\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right) = -5 + \frac{5\sqrt{3}}{2} \approx -5 + 4.3301 = -0.6699\). Rounded to one decimal place, this is \(-0.7\).
